field.label: Enabled
field.help: Include this peer in BIRD. Disabled peers are not written into the active include list.

field.label: Name
field.help: BIRD protocol name (must be unique). The include file is /usr/local/etc/bird/NAME.inc.

field.label: Neighbor
field.help: BGP neighbor IPv4 or IPv6 address.

field.label: Source Address
field.help: Optional source address for BGP session (typically WAN IPv4). Leave empty to omit the statement.

field.label: IPv4
field.help: Enable IPv4 BGP family for this peer.

field.label: IPv4 Import
field.help: none, all, or a filter name defined in bird.conf (e.g. accept_refilter).

field.label: IPv4 Community name
field.help: Name of the community include file (without path). Written as /usr/local/etc/bird/NAME.inc and used as the BIRD define name (e.g. ANTIFILTER_DOWNLOAD).

field.label: IPv4 Community
field.help: Communities as pairs: 65444, 120 or 65444:200 (also 65444,:210). Saved in the inc file as (65444, 120), (65444, 200).

field.label: IPv6
field.help: Enable IPv6 BGP family for this peer.

field.label: IPv6 Import
field.help: none, all, or a filter name (e.g. accept_antifilter_network_v6).

field.label: IPv6 Community name
field.help: Name of the IPv6 community include file (without path), used as the BIRD define name.

field.label: IPv6 Community
field.help: Same pair syntax as IPv4 Community. Saved as (ASN, VALUE) tuples in the inc file.
